fixturePolicy: Repository public history only; neutral requests; no session or memory text

recordFields.name: v
recordFields.meaning: record schema version, equal to this manifest's v

recordFields.name: run
recordFields.meaning: one condition run

recordFields.name: task
recordFields.meaning: task_id(base, requestHash, checksHash); the only task derivation

recordFields.name: ledgerTask
recordFields.meaning: reserved: the run ledger's task id; null (unknown) until that ledger is on this base

recordFields.name: fixture
recordFields.meaning: fixture name

recordFields.name: base
recordFields.meaning: base commit every condition starts from

recordFields.name: requestHash
recordFields.meaning: hash of the exact request text

recordFields.name: checksHash
recordFields.meaning: hash of the hidden checks, neighbouring check paths and protected paths

recordFields.name: harness
recordFields.meaning: CLI that ran every agent in the run

recordFields.name: mode
recordFields.meaning: condition requested

recordFields.name: actualChoice
recordFields.meaning: what a chooser run did; null otherwise

recordFields.name: simulated
recordFields.meaning: true for fake agent processes; never evidence

recordFields.name: outcome
recordFields.meaning: how the run ended

recordFields.name: failure
recordFields.meaning: why a run did not complete

recordFields.name: fannedOut
recordFields.meaning: managed: true only if the lead created at least one helper; null for solo

recordFields.name: helperCount
recordFields.meaning: helpers on the production record (children of the lead)

recordFields.name: helpers
recordFields.meaning: per helper: agent id and checkout, relative to the run root

recordFields.name: delegationAttempts
recordFields.meaning: delegation requests seen from a lead whose condition forbids them

recordFields.name: tokens
recordFields.meaning: input, output, cacheRead, cacheWrite; each int or null when unknown

recordFields.name: usageComplete
recordFields.meaning: true only when every token type is known and no session had a reset, fork or gap

recordFields.name: usageProblems
recordFields.meaning: why usage is incomplete

recordFields.name: wallSeconds
recordFields.meaning: submission to the last agent's terminal event

recordFields.name: activeSeconds
recordFields.meaning: union of agent process intervals

recordFields.name: humanSteps
recordFields.meaning: interventions; null until coded

recordFields.name: diffHash
recordFields.meaning: hash of the carried-over changes

recordFields.name: changedPaths
recordFields.meaning: paths the agent changed, added or removed

recordFields.name: tampered
recordFields.meaning: protected paths the agent changed, and unsafe entries

recordFields.name: checks
recordFields.meaning: per check: passed, failed, error:<kind> or noResult, written by the grading harness

recordFields.name: gradeResult
recordFields.meaning: grading harness verdict

recordFields.name: hiddenPassed
recordFields.meaning: every hidden check reported passed

recordFields.name: neighbourPassed
recordFields.meaning: every neighbouring check reported passed

recordFields.name: passed
recordFields.meaning: completed, untampered, and every check reported passed
